raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
2022 - NOW
Workday Integration Consultant
Cognizant Technology
Solutions
Worked closely with clients to understand their needs, gathered requirements, and built integration solutions.
Fixed integration errors by checking logs, troubleshooting Workday Studio issues, and helping clients resolve data problems.
Designed and developed integrations using EIB, Core Connectors, PECI, Workday Studio, and RaaS reports.
Provided ongoing support for AMS and post-launch projects by fixing issues, improving performance, and making updates based on user feedback.
Customized Workday Studio integrations to automate daily data checks and meet business requirements.
Performed Workday Release Testing to make sure integrations worked correctly and followed compliance rules.
Created change requests and detailed documentation, including build guides, test plans, and migration documents to ensure smooth updates and transitions.
Built, tested, and verified integrations during implementation, then retested in Sandbox with updated data before migrating to production.
